style: Read this aloud warmly and clearly, with gentle excitement, like a friendly nature guide talking to a class of seven-year-olds
lines: Welcome to the rainforest. What living things can you find?
You found all 14 kinds of living things in the rainforest!
Welcome to the desert. What living things can you find?
You found all 7 kinds of living things in the desert!
Welcome to the pond. What living things can you find?
You found all 10 kinds of living things in the pond!
Welcome to the backyard. What living things can you find?
You found all 9 kinds of living things in the backyard!
Which habitat has the most different kinds of living things?
Some living things are still hiding. Go back and find them all.
